# JetOptions Private Jets

> > JetOptions is an ARGUS and Wyvern-certified on-demand private jet charter broker offering 5,000+ global aircraft with fixed hourly rates, empty leg specials, and luxury travel concierge services.

JetOptions provides comprehensive private aviation solutions including on-demand charter flights, jet card memberships, aircraft acquisitions, and specialized services like medical air transport. The company maintains FAA Part 135 and EU-OPS certification with offices in major hubs including Chicago, New York, Miami, Dallas, and Los Angeles.
